meta.title: QCS L1 highlight respects hide_tna_bid_from_qcs setting
gaps: Enable or verify the tenant setting hide_tna_bid_from_qcs.
Prepare or access a live RFQ containing both a TNA bid from Vendor A and a regular bid from another vendor with comparable landed prices.
Observe that the TNA bid is absent from the ranking table.
Verify that the next-lowest regular bid is highlighted as L1.
